title: Privacy Preserving XAI
summary: Source code accompanying an Elsevier Knowledge-Based Systems paper on integrating privacy-enhancing technologies (differential privacy, synthetic data) into explainable AI pipelines for tabular datasets like Adult, Credit, Compas and Hospital. The SynDataGen_SDV notebook imports sdv.single_table's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer alongside SingleTableMetadata to fit and generate synthetic training data, with SDV run directly as one of the privacy-enhancing techniques compared in the study.
